# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Overview

This is a **GitHub profile repository** (`viniciusks/viniciusks`). Its content renders as the profile README on `github.com/viniciusks`. There is no application code — the repo consists of:

- `README.md` — the public-facing GitHub profile page (HTML/Markdown with badge/icon embeds)
- `.github/workflows/cobrinha.yml` — a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that regenerates the contribution snake animation every 12 hours, pushing the SVG output to the `output` branch

## Key Conventions

- **Profile README** uses inline HTML (`<div>`, `<img>`) mixed with Markdown for layout control (icon grid, badge row, horizontal rule `##`).
- Icons are sourced from `devicons` (via `raw.githubusercontent.com/devicons/devicon`) and `cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/devicons/devicon`.
- Badges use the `shields.io` format: `https://img.shields.io/badge/...`.
- The snake SVG lives at `dist/github-contribution-grid-snake.svg` on the `output` branch and is generated by [`Platane/snk`](https://github.com/Platane/snk).

## Workflow

The `cobrinha.yml` workflow:
1. Runs on a schedule (`*/12 * * * *`) and on `workflow_dispatch`.
2. Uses `Platane/snk@master` to generate the snake SVG from `viniciusks`'s contribution graph.
3. Pushes the output to the `output` branch via `crazy-max/ghaction-github-pages@v2.1.3`.
